definition: A free-text summary describing the event, situation, or record.
The skos:Concept URI this metric, dimension, or attribute realises. Multiple metrics may share a single concept_uri when they measure the same underlying notion through different operationalisations.
The LinkML range or external code list URI that constrains the values of a dimension or attribute. Named 'value_range' rather than 'range' to avoid shadowing the LinkML keyword.
The SDMX attachment level for this attribute: dataset, series (dimension-group), or observation. The level determines where the SDMX emitter places the attribute on output.
